name: Mesutcydev Apps
subtitle: Local-first apps for iPhone and iPad
description: A source for Mesutcydev's sideloadable iOS and iPadOS apps, including local AI, remote-control, media, and developer tools.

apps.name: On Device: LAS
apps.subtitle: A local AI server for iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription: On Device: LAS runs supported language models locally on your iPhone and exposes authenticated OpenAI-, Anthropic-, and Ollama-compatible APIs over your trusted local network. It does not silently fall back to a cloud service.

versions.localizedDescription: Sideload release with HTTP chunked streaming, GGUF chat templates and per-request samplers, Tailscale URL advertising, and Core AI conversation transcripts.
Sideload release with the local API server, coordinated on-device model runtime, and a sideload-safe Files import fallback.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: On Device: LAS exposes your selected on-device language model to trusted computers on your local network.

apps.name: ForgeSign
apps.subtitle: Sign and install IPAs on-device.
apps.localizedDescription: ForgeSign is an on-device IPA re-signer for iPhone and iPad. Sign, install, and manage your own app builds locally without sending certificates or IPAs to a server.

versions.localizedDescription: Current unsigned sideload build with the latest signing and file-selection fixes.
Adds the Sources tab, IPA preflight, optional dylib injection, and refreshed Liquid Glass surfaces.

apps.name: MacPair for iOS
apps.subtitle: A local-first remote desktop client for Mac.
apps.localizedDescription: MacPair for iOS connects to an approved MacPair Host on your local network for screen sharing, keyboard and pointer control, clipboard sync, file transfer, audio, and optional remote-terminal access.

versions.localizedDescription: Current iOS client release. The IPA is unsigned and is intended to be re-signed by the installer.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: MacPair uses your local network to discover and connect to Macs running MacPair Host.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MacPair captures your voice for on-device dictation into your approved Mac.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: MacPair transcribes your voice on-device so you can dictate text into your approved Mac.

apps.name: OnDevice LLM
apps.subtitle: A local-first AI workbench for iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription: OnDevice LLM runs supported language, vision, voice, and image-generation workloads on your iPhone. It includes local model management, camera and voice features, retrieval tools, and an authenticated local API without silently falling back to a cloud service.

versions.localizedDescription: Silver eye icon and matching splash, chat typography and voice/Lens polish, and llama.cpp v0.4.0. Existing generation and memory policies retained. App and share-extension entitlements verified; installer re-signing required. Physical-device model regression testing remains open.

Reliability and accessibility update: safer download retry/deletion, sync reconciliation and controls, guided setup, installation preflight, and ONNX Runtime 1.29.0. Full app and share-extension entitlements retained; installer re-signing required. Models download on demand.
Sideload build with the local AI workbench, share extension, and bundled memory entitlements.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: OnDevice LLM uses the back camera to capture live video of your terminal or code editor for real-time analysis.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: OnDevice LLM can expose your on-device language model to computers on your local network when you enable the Local API Server.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: OnDevice LLM uses the microphone for hold-to-talk dictation in the chat composer. Audio is transcribed on-device and never leaves your phone.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: OnDevice LLM can analyze code from photos in your library.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: OnDevice LLM uses on-device speech recognition to convert your voice into text for the chat composer.

apps.name: OnDevice Core
apps.subtitle: Local AI studio for iOS 27.
apps.localizedDescription: The iOS 27 Core edition: local chat, Lens, voice, image generation, and model management. Includes the silver eye identity, improved streaming presentation, cancellable document search, and inspectable source excerpts. Installer re-signing is required; profiles must authorize the requested entitlements.

versions.localizedDescription: Silver eye logo and matching splash, chat and voice refinements, safer document imports, and source excerpts. Verified Payload layout and exact app/share-extension entitlements; re-signing required.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: OnDevice uses the back camera to capture live video of your terminal or code editor for real-time analysis.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: OnDevice can expose your on-device language model to computers on your local network when you enable the Local API Server.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: OnDevice uses the microphone for hold-to-talk dictation in the chat composer. Audio is transcribed on-device and never leaves your phone.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: OnDevice can analyze code from photos in your library.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: OnDevice uses on-device speech recognition to convert your voice into text for the chat composer.

apps.name: SiteAgent
apps.subtitle: Manage websites from an AI agent on iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription: SiteAgent lets you connect GitHub repositories, edit websites with natural language, review visual diffs, preview changes, and commit approved updates from your iPhone. It supports cloud and on-device AI providers.

versions.localizedDescription: Current sideload-unlocked release with website editing, AI routing, previews, deployment integrations, and local-model support.

apps.name: Core AI: LAS
apps.subtitle: A Core AI model server for iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription: Core AI: LAS runs supported Core AI language and vision models locally on iPhone and exposes the selected model through an authenticated local API. This build requires iOS 27 or newer.

versions.localizedDescription: Current Core AI sideload release with the authenticated local model server and required memory entitlements.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Core AI: LAS exposes your selected on-device Core AI model to trusted computers on your local network.

apps.name: Hubr
apps.subtitle: A smart TV remote with fast text entry.
apps.localizedDescription: Hubr discovers supported smart TVs on your local network and provides remote controls, pairing, text entry, and optional on-device voice dictation.

versions.localizedDescription: Current unsigned sideload build with the latest smart-TV text-entry fix.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Hubr finds your smart TVs on your Wi-Fi to pair with them and send remote-control commands. Your video, audio, and account data never leave your home.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Hubr uses the microphone for voice dictation so you can type into TV apps like Netflix and YouTube by speaking instead of using the on-screen keyboard.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Hubr transcribes your voice on-device so dictated text can be sent to the TV's text field. Audio never leaves your iPhone.

apps.name: Vamp Stream
apps.subtitle: The iPad streaming companion for Vamp Sync.
apps.localizedDescription: Vamp Stream connects an iPad to an approved Mac running Vamp Sync, Vamp Host, or Vamp Assistant for private local-network screen streaming and remote interaction.

versions.localizedDescription: Current unsigned AltStore build of the iPad streaming client for Vamp Sync.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Vamp Stream uses the camera to scan the private Vamp Assistant pairing QR code.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Vamp Stream uses your local network to discover and connect to Macs running Vamp Host or Vamp Assistant.

apps.name: Vamp Assistant
apps.subtitle: Your Mac assistant in your pocket.
apps.localizedDescription: Vamp Assistant pairs with an approved Mac so you can continue assistant sessions, control the pointer and keyboard, and use private LAN or Tailscale connectivity from iPhone or iPad.

versions.localizedDescription: Current unsigned iPhone and iPad companion build with secure Mac pairing and remote input.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Vamp Assistant scans the one-time pairing QR code shown by your Mac.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Vamp Assistant connects to Vamp Assistant running on your trusted Mac.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Vamp Assistant can dictate text onto your Mac from the Control keyboard.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Vamp Assistant turns on-device speech into keystrokes on your Mac.

apps.name: Bell Link
apps.subtitle: A focused multi-provider AI chat client.
apps.localizedDescription: Bell Link is a lightweight chat client with provider selection, photo attachments, and optional voice dictation.

versions.localizedDescription: Current unsigned sideload build with multi-provider chat, photo attachments, and voice dictation.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Bell Link can attach photos you take to a chat when you choose to use the camera.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Bell Link uses the microphone for optional voice dictation into the chat composer.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Bell Link lets you choose photos to attach to a chat.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Bell Link uses speech recognition to turn your speech into text in the composer.

apps.name: Diffusion Forge
apps.subtitle: Generate images locally on iPhone and iPad.
apps.localizedDescription: Diffusion Forge is an on-device image-generation studio with local model downloads, text-to-image and image-to-image workflows, and photo-library export.

versions.localizedDescription: Current unsigned sideload build for on-device image generation.

privacy.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: iOS Image Generation needs access to store downloaded models and generated images.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: iOS Image Generation needs access to save generated images to your photo library.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: iOS Image Generation needs access to your photo library for image-to-image generation.

apps.name: CompressKit
apps.subtitle: Private on-device file compression and conversion.
apps.localizedDescription: CompressKit compresses and converts images, videos, audio, PDFs, and archives entirely on your device. This sideload build enables all Pro compression and conversion controls without StoreKit.

versions.localizedDescription: Unsigned unlocked sideload build with all Pro features enabled and the CompressKit share extension included.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: CompressKit needs permission to save your compressed and converted files to your photo library.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: CompressKit needs access to your photo library to import Live Photos and extract their video.
